node.title: Re^4: Session being destroyed
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
A typical HTTP exchange would look like this:

  1. Request GET / HTTP/1.1 ...
  2. Response HTTP/1.1 200 OK Set-Cookie: foo=bar ... ... ...
  3. Request GET /image.gif HTTP/1.1 ... Cookie: foo=bar

I.e. the cookie is available immediately, and will be sent with the request for the image. Like [chromatic], I am confused what kind of a scenario you are describing; I'm also not sure how all of this might apply to the OP's question. Perhaps you could show a more detailed description (like I did above) of the scenario you are imagining; otherwise, I think you're mistaken about the order of the requests (even asynchronous ones).
